_doc: SFX cues for film 15 v2 (remake). 'at' is on the NARRATION clock like sfx_cues.json: conform15.py adds OFF=0.10 s, and picture frame g shows at film time g/30, so at = g/30 - 0.10 (the g of each cue is in its note, as the frame number in the final conform; take frame index = g - first_g). 'align':'onset' makes 'at' the first transient (contact / whip peak). Levels, ducking and bed tiling as in v1. 1963 Medford = sawdust/cinder sounds, 1968/1972 stadium = foam/rubber/crowd; beds follow the location changes.
